Add booking cancellation: cancel(bookingId, at)

cancel() cancels a booking at a UTC instant and returns { bookingId, refund }.
A booking cancelled 24 hours or more before its start is refunded its full
total; otherwise nothing. Cancelled bookings no longer hold their item, and a
booking can only be cancelled once. Documented in the README and covered by
tests.
